findings.rationale: Avoid direct root access
findings.remediation: Use an unprivileged account and reviewed sudo permissions before disabling direct root login.

findings.rationale: Prefer managed public-key authentication
findings.remediation: Verify working key access and recovery access before disabling password authentication.

findings.rationale: Password-free baseline; MFA deployments need a different policy
findings.remediation: Review PAM/MFA requirements before disabling keyboard-interactive authentication.

findings.rationale: Reject empty-password logins
findings.remediation: Set PermitEmptyPasswords no and verify the effective configuration.

findings.rationale: Require the intended key authentication mechanism
findings.remediation: Provision and test public keys before enforcing key-only access.

findings.rationale: Reduce unnecessary forwarding surface
findings.remediation: Disable X11 forwarding unless required for an approved workflow.

findings.rationale: Limit authentication attempts per connection
findings.remediation: Choose MaxAuthTries 4 or lower, considering multi-key clients.

findings.rationale: Reject trust based on the connecting host's identity
findings.remediation: Set HostbasedAuthentication no unless a reviewed host-trust design requires it.

findings.rationale: Prevent users from injecting environment variables that can bypass restrictions
findings.remediation: Set PermitUserEnvironment no and review any workflow that relied on ~/.ssh/environment.

findings.rationale: Limit how long an unauthenticated connection may stay open (0 means no limit)
findings.remediation: Choose LoginGraceTime between 1 and 60 seconds; the OpenSSH default is longer.

findings.rationale: Reduce tunnelling surface on hosts that are not jump hosts
findings.remediation: Set AllowTcpForwarding no unless bastion or tunnelling use is approved; consider Match blocks for exceptions.

findings.rationale: Keep enough logging to attribute logins; QUIET or FATAL hide authentication events
findings.remediation: Use LogLevel INFO or VERBOSE and confirm logs are retained.

findings.rationale: Forwarding depends on host role
findings.remediation: Review the host role; forwarding is expected on a router and disabled on this workstation baseline.

findings.rationale: Enable SYN-cookie fallback
findings.remediation: Review net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies; this is a fallback, not a capacity solution.

findings.rationale: Reject IPv4 source routes at the all scope
findings.remediation: Review all/default/per-interface source-route policy; this check alone does not cover every interface.

findings.rationale: Set safer defaults for new interfaces
findings.remediation: Review default and existing interface source-route settings.

findings.rationale: Reverse-path filtering drops packets with spoofed source addresses (2 = loose mode, used with asymmetric routing)
findings.remediation: Set rp_filter to 1 (strict) or 2 (loose) after checking for asymmetric routing.

findings.rationale: Ignore ICMP redirects that can alter routing
findings.remediation: Review accept_redirects at all/default/per-interface scope.

findings.rationale: Do not answer broadcast echo requests
findings.remediation: Set net.ipv4.icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts to 1.

findings.rationale: Use full address-space randomisation on supported Linux systems
findings.remediation: Review kernel.randomize_va_space and application compatibility.

findings.rationale: Hide kernel pointers from unprivileged users
findings.remediation: Set kernel.kptr_restrict to 1 or 2.

findings.rationale: Restrict kernel log access to privileged users
findings.remediation: Set kernel.dmesg_restrict to 1 after checking monitoring agents that read dmesg.

findings.rationale: Mitigate symlink races in world-writable sticky directories
findings.remediation: Set fs.protected_symlinks to 1.

findings.rationale: Prevent hardlinks to files the user cannot read or write
findings.remediation: Set fs.protected_hardlinks to 1.
